content.label:
I am almost completely blind, so to have this app make typing easier is amazing. Apple's dictation, as we all know, is terrible and seems to have only gotten worse with each iOS update. I am happy to say that this app has resolved all of my dictation issues. Whether I'm chatting with friends or getting work done, it has made me more productive, and I absolutely love this application.

Huge thanks to the developers. You guys are doing a great job. Keep up the great work. I highly recommend this app to everyone, especially if you use dictation. The accuracy is insane.
